verdict.rationale: Terraform's first-party pieces cover the core workflow. Its official MCP server supports AI generation of configuration in human-readable files. `terraform plan -out=FILE` saves a reviewable plan, and `terraform show` (with `-json`) plus the `-json` UI stream give human-readable and machine-readable diffs. Apply then prompts for approval or executes the saved plan. Missing for 10: the MCP server only exposes registry docs, modules and policies rather than running plan or apply, non-interactive or headless plan flags are implied rather than explicitly documented, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent-driven plan-and-approve loop.
